name: Useful capabilities
explanation: Start with a real task. Complete the useful flow and check that people can get the outcome they need.

name: Clear ownership
icon: <circle cx="16" cy="7" r="4"/><path d="M16 11v6M6 22v-5h20v5"/><rect x="3" y="22" width="6" height="7" rx="1"/><rect x="23" y="22" width="6" height="7" rx="1"/>
explanation: Keep one owner for every important fact; route changes through that owner to avoid mismatches.

name: Understandable design
icon: <path data-motion-part="layer" d="m16 3 13 7-13 7L3 10Z"/><path data-motion-part="layer" d="m3 17 13 7 13-7"/><path data-motion-part="layer" d="m3 22 13 7 13-7"/>
explanation: Show how responsibilities and dependencies fit together. Explain decisions that are not obvious in code.

name: Coherent evolution
explanation: Change connected parts together, removing replaced behavior and obsolete paths so the system stays coherent.

name: Faithful results
explanation: When transforming data, preserve its meaning, identity, units, order, and relationships.

name: Informed control
icon: <path data-motion-part="tracks" d="M7 4v24M16 4v24M25 4v24"/><rect data-motion-part="slider" x="4" y="9" width="6" height="6" rx="1" fill="currentColor"/><rect data-motion-part="slider" x="13" y="20" width="6" height="6" rx="1" fill="currentColor"/><rect data-motion-part="slider" x="22" y="7" width="6" height="6" rx="1" fill="currentColor"/>
explanation: Make choices and consequences easy to see, ask permission when it matters, honor boundaries, and allow people to stop.

name: Honest state and effects
icon: <circle cx="16" cy="16" r="12"/><path data-motion-part="minute" d="M16 8v8"/><path data-motion-part="hour" d="M16 16l5 3"/><path d="M7 5l-3 3"/><circle data-motion-part="pivot" cx="16" cy="16" r="1" fill="currentColor"/>
explanation: Say what happened as far as it is known, marking each outcome pending, completed, failed, or uncertain.

name: Usable interfaces
explanation: Use clear labels, consistent controls, and timely feedback so people know what to do next and what it will do.

name: Actionable failures
explanation: Explain what failed, why it failed, and what could help next; keep evidence, protect privacy.

name: Dependable recovery
explanation: When work is interrupted, make retries safe: retain commitments and avoid repeating effects that may have taken place.

name: Bounded resource use
icon: <path data-motion-part="frame" d="M4 27V5h24v22Z"/><line data-motion-part="bar" x1="10" y1="22" x2="10" y2="15"/><line data-motion-part="bar" x1="16" y1="22" x2="16" y2="9"/><line data-motion-part="bar" x1="22" y1="22" x2="22" y2="12"/>
explanation: Set limits for time, memory, storage, and repeated work. Count retries and failures, and stop when more won't help.

name: Trustworthy evidence
icon: <path data-motion-part="check" d="m8 13 3 3 6-7"/><g data-motion-part="magnifier"><circle data-motion-part="lens" cx="13" cy="13" r="8"/><path d="m19 19 7 7"/></g>
explanation: Check whether observations could contradict a claim. Describe what the evidence establishes, and what remains unshown.

name: Transferable knowledge
icon: <defs><g id="knowledge-sheet"><path fill="var(--icon-paper)" d="M16 8c4-4 9-4 13-3v21c-5-2-9-1-13 2Z"/><path d="M20 11l5-1M20 16l5-1"/></g></defs><g data-motion-part="cover"><use href="#knowledge-sheet" transform="translate(32 0) scale(-1 1)"/><use href="#knowledge-sheet"/></g><g data-motion-part="page"><use href="#knowledge-sheet"/></g><path data-motion-part="spine" d="M16 8v20"/>
explanation: Leave clear reasoning and steps for the next person, and update docs as behavior changes.

name: Protected information
icon: <path data-motion-part="shield" d="M16 3 27 7v8c0 7-5 11-11 14C10 26 5 22 5 15V7Z"/><rect data-motion-part="body" x="11" y="14" width="10" height="8" rx="1"/><g data-motion-part="shackle"><path d="M13 14v-3a3 3 0 0 1 6 0v3"/></g><path data-motion-part="keyhole" d="M16 17v2"/>
explanation: Collect and share only what you need. Keep private data safe in storage, interfaces, logs, and diagnostics.

name: Reproducible results
explanation: Record inputs, versions, settings, and methods; say whether reproduction is exact or approximate.

name: Reasoned improvement
explanation: Work out what's wrong before changing it. Say why the fix should help, then compare its effect with what you expected.

name: Verified completion
explanation: Finish what was promised, check the outcome where it matters, handle relevant findings, and report limitations.
